adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#show` and `#update` both just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`, so the PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` endpoint does not persist anything. The spec `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb` indeed only asserts inheritance and would not catch this. However, in the provided admin UI template (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) there is no “save changes” button wired to `saveChanges`; actual persistence of hosts appears to happen via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create/update/destroy` when `host.save(props)` is called from the component. So it’s a real, diff-grounded concern (dead/no-op endpoint + inadequate test) but not clearly a user-facing correctness bug in this diff alone.
